description: User correction of one column's semantic role (and analyte) for a dataset. Stored in the dataset metadata (semantic_overrides); applied by geochemistry.column_roles with source='user' and confidence 'high'. semantic_role null removes the correction. Never reads or changes a value.

analyte.description: Only for major_oxide, trace_element, ree or assay; must belong to that role's vocabulary.

response.description: Same response as geochemistry.column_roles, after applying the correction.
